props.html: Dear Rye Brook Resident, Rye Brook Recreation has been working on its spring and summer programs. Our Little League season will open on April 11th. Registration for Day Camp, Teen Travel Camp, Little League Softball, Recreation Baseball, Rookie League and T-Ball is ongoing. For all other programs, registration will begin on March 19th at 9:30pm. Highlights for this spring/summer season are Young Inventors, Build-a-Biz: Lemonade Stand, Girls Youth Volleyball, Grit Ninja, Youth & Adult Badminton, Men’s and Women’s Softball, Adult Zumba, Snapology, and Pickleball Impact Zone.

The Village of Rye Brook Recreation Department is part of the South East Consortium for Special Services, Inc., which is a not- for-profit organization, dedicated to providing leisure services to eligible citizens with developmental or other disabilities. The

South East Consortium offers a variety of programs and services in an effort to meet the physical, social, cultural and quality of life needs of children and adults of all ages and functioning abilities. We try to base all activities on the appropriateness of the partici- pant and availability of resources. We welcome your participa- tion. For further information contact the South East Consortium, 914-698-5232, 740 West Boston Post Road, Suite 301, Mamaron- eck, New York 10543.

The Rye Brook Recreation Department operates 8 tennis courts at 2 facilities. Four are located at Pine Ridge Park (corner of Mohegan Lane and Latonia Road), and four at Harkness Park (by
Tennis Courts will officially open for the season onApril 1, 2026. A valid 2026 tennis and
pickleball permit through Court Reserve is required to reserve a time slot. NOTE:Non-

residents are not permitted to play tennis on Village Courts without being accompanied by a resident with a valid permit or a non-resident may purchase a non-resident permit through Court Reserve.Permits may be purchased throughout the season in Court Reserve.

Tennis Courts 1 & 2 at Pine Ridge Park are reserved for Rye Brook approved lessons Tuesday and Wednesday from 9:00am-6:00pm. Tennis lessons approved by the Recreation Department have priority on Pine Ridge Park Courts 1 & 2. Schedule to be determined by registration de- mands.Only lessons through the Recreation Department are permitted on the courts.
The Blind Brook High School Tennis Teams use the Harkness and Pine Ridge Courts during April, May and the first week of June, weekdays from 3:00pm –6:00pm.
While signing up for a family permit, please sign up everyone in your family that will be using the courts. If they are not signed up they will not receive a permit.

Making a reservation: A reservation is required for usage of Rye Brook’s 8 tennis courts and 6 pickleball courts. Reservations must be done through Court Reserve App on a first come first served basis. In order to make a reservation, you must be in possession of a valid 2026 tennis or pickleball permit through Court Reserve. All players on the court must be in your reservation during the weekday time slots. Non Court Reserve permit holders will be charged a $5 fee to the permit holder making the reservation. Reserva- tions can be done up to the minute of court time for residents (different rules for non-res.). Court times will be 1 hour in duration and begin on the hour. Through your app on your phone, you will be able to see court availability and make your reservation at your desired time. Enjoy your tennis and pickleball experience and please be safe!
